notes: Every scripts/tests/cases/<id>/ with prompt.txt must appear in exactly one bucket. training = core agent behaviors (default npm test). verification = still run for release confidence, not the default smoke set. excluded = intentional skip with a reason. Unit tests (src/**/*.test.ts) are CI verification via test:unit and are not listed here.

training.follow-skill: Load a project skill and follow its steps before training — core skill + aq loop.
training.use-tool: Prefer an existing train tool over inventing a new script.
training.file-a-job: Detach long work into jobs/ instead of blocking the foreground.
training.status-diff-checkout: Inspect status/diff without mutating the train checkout.
training.stay-in-train: Sandbox: refuse writing outside the train (tmp / parent escapes).
training.recover-failed-tool: Continue after a failed tool and finish the task.

verification.fork-dont-mutate: Fork + train a variant without mutating the parent recipe — longer path, release verify.
verification.run-aq-eval: Train then run aq eval and report failure honestly — credential/aq-heavy verify.
